ZSA_FA_DSO_tb_dd.@DataWarehouse.tableFunction.script:
RETURN

SELECT
    CURRENT_DATE AS "AS_OF_DATE",

    CAST(
        :P_RBLS_ROLLING_AVERAGE_MONTHS
        AS INTEGER
    ) AS "AR_ROLLING_MONTHS",

    CAST(
        :P_REVN_ROLLING_AVERAGE_MONTHS
        AS INTEGER
    ) AS "REVENUE_ROLLING_MONTHS",

    AR."COMPANY_CODE"
        AS "COMPANY_CODE",

    AR."CUSTOMER"
        AS "CUSTOMER",

    AR."CURRENCY"
        AS "CURRENCY",

    CAST(
        AR."AR_ROLLING_TOTAL"
        AS DECIMAL(31,6)
    ) AS "AR_ROLLING_TOTAL",

    CAST(
        AR."AVERAGE_MONTHLY_AR"
        AS DECIMAL(31,6)
    ) AS "AVERAGE_MONTHLY_AR",

    CAST(
        COALESCE(
            REV."REVENUE_ROLLING_TOTAL",
            0
        )
        AS DECIMAL(31,6)
    ) AS "REVENUE_ROLLING_TOTAL",

    CAST(
        COALESCE(
            REV."AVERAGE_MONTHLY_REVENUE",
            0
        )
        AS DECIMAL(31,6)
    ) AS "AVERAGE_MONTHLY_REVENUE",

    CASE
        WHEN CAST(
                 :P_RBLS_ROLLING_AVERAGE_MONTHS
                 AS INTEGER
             ) <= 0

          OR CAST(
                 :P_REVN_ROLLING_AVERAGE_MONTHS
                 AS INTEGER
             ) <= 0

        THEN CAST(
            NULL AS DECIMAL(31,0)
        )

        WHEN REV."AVERAGE_MONTHLY_REVENUE" IS NULL
          OR REV."AVERAGE_MONTHLY_REVENUE" = 0

        THEN CAST(
            0 AS DECIMAL(31,0)
        )

        ELSE CAST(
            ROUND(
                30
                * AR."AVERAGE_MONTHLY_AR"
                / REV."AVERAGE_MONTHLY_REVENUE",
                0
            )
            AS DECIMAL(31,0)
        )
    END AS "DSO_DAYS"

FROM
(
    SELECT
        AR_MONTHLY."COMPANY_CODE",
        AR_MONTHLY."CUSTOMER",
        AR_MONTHLY."CURRENCY",

        SUM(
            AR_MONTHLY."AR_AT_KEY_DATE"
        ) AS "AR_ROLLING_TOTAL",

        CAST(
            SUM(
                AR_MONTHLY."AR_AT_KEY_DATE"
            )
            /
            CAST(
                :P_RBLS_ROLLING_AVERAGE_MONTHS
                AS INTEGER
            )
            AS DECIMAL(31,6)
        ) AS "AVERAGE_MONTHLY_AR"

    FROM
    (
        SELECT
            AR_SOURCE."CompanyCode"
                AS "COMPANY_CODE",

            AR_SOURCE."Customer"
                AS "CUSTOMER",

            AR_SOURCE."GlobalCurrency"
                AS "CURRENCY",

            KEY_DATES."KEY_DATE"
                AS "KEY_DATE",

            SUM(
                CAST(
                    AR_SOURCE."AmountInGlobalCurrency"
                    AS DECIMAL(31,6)
                )
            ) AS "AR_AT_KEY_DATE"

        FROM "ZSA_HL_AR_AGEING1" AR_SOURCE

        CROSS JOIN
        (
            SELECT
                CASE
                    WHEN SERIES_DATA."GENERATED_PERIOD_START" = 0
                    THEN CURRENT_DATE

                    ELSE LAST_DAY(
                        ADD_MONTHS(
                            CURRENT_DATE,
                            - SERIES_DATA."GENERATED_PERIOD_START"
                        )
                    )
                END AS "KEY_DATE"

            FROM SERIES_GENERATE_INTEGER(
                1,
                0,
                CAST(
                    :P_RBLS_ROLLING_AVERAGE_MONTHS
                    AS INTEGER
                )
            ) SERIES_DATA

        ) KEY_DATES

        WHERE CAST(
                  :P_RBLS_ROLLING_AVERAGE_MONTHS
                  AS INTEGER
              ) > 0

          AND AR_SOURCE."PostingDate" IS NOT NULL

          AND TRIM(
                  TO_VARCHAR(
                      AR_SOURCE."PostingDate"
                  )
              ) <> ''

          AND TRIM(
                  TO_VARCHAR(
                      AR_SOURCE."PostingDate"
                  )
              ) <> '00000000'

          AND TRIM(
                  TO_VARCHAR(
                      AR_SOURCE."PostingDate"
                  )
              ) <> '0000-00-00'

          AND LENGTH(
                  TRIM(
                      TO_VARCHAR(
                          AR_SOURCE."PostingDate"
                      )
                  )
              ) = 10

          AND TO_DATE(
                  TRIM(
                      TO_VARCHAR(
                          AR_SOURCE."PostingDate"
                      )
                  ),
                  'YYYY-MM-DD'
              ) <= KEY_DATES."KEY_DATE"

          AND
          (
                 AR_SOURCE."ClearingDate" IS NULL

              OR TRIM(
                     TO_VARCHAR(
                         AR_SOURCE."ClearingDate"
                     )
                 ) = ''

              OR TRIM(
                     TO_VARCHAR(
                         AR_SOURCE."ClearingDate"
                     )
                 ) = '00000000'

              OR TRIM(
                     TO_VARCHAR(
                         AR_SOURCE."ClearingDate"
                     )
                 ) = '0000-00-00'

              OR
              (
                  LENGTH(
                      TRIM(
                          TO_VARCHAR(
                              AR_SOURCE."ClearingDate"
                          )
                      )
                  ) = 10

                  AND TO_DATE(
                          TRIM(
                              TO_VARCHAR(
                                  AR_SOURCE."ClearingDate"
                              )
                          ),
                          'YYYY-MM-DD'
                      ) > KEY_DATES."KEY_DATE"
              )
          )

        GROUP BY
            AR_SOURCE."CompanyCode",
            AR_SOURCE."Customer",
            AR_SOURCE."GlobalCurrency",
            KEY_DATES."KEY_DATE"

    ) AR_MONTHLY

    GROUP BY
        AR_MONTHLY."COMPANY_CODE",
        AR_MONTHLY."CUSTOMER",
        AR_MONTHLY."CURRENCY"

) AR

LEFT OUTER JOIN
(
    SELECT
        SALES_SOURCE."CompanyCode"
            AS "COMPANY_CODE",

        SALES_SOURCE."PayerParty"
            AS "CUSTOMER",

        SALES_SOURCE."TransactionCurrency"
            AS "CURRENCY",

        SUM(
            CAST(
                SALES_SOURCE."SIGNED_NET_CREDIT_VALUE"
                AS DECIMAL(31,6)
            )
        ) AS "REVENUE_ROLLING_TOTAL",

        CAST(
            SUM(
                CAST(
                    SALES_SOURCE."SIGNED_NET_CREDIT_VALUE"
                    AS DECIMAL(31,6)
                )
            )
            /
            CAST(
                :P_REVN_ROLLING_AVERAGE_MONTHS
                AS INTEGER
            )
            AS DECIMAL(31,6)
        ) AS "AVERAGE_MONTHLY_REVENUE"

    FROM "ZSA_HL_DSO_NET_CREDIT_SALES1" SALES_SOURCE

    WHERE CAST(
              :P_REVN_ROLLING_AVERAGE_MONTHS
              AS INTEGER
          ) > 0

      AND SALES_SOURCE."BillingDocumentDate" IS NOT NULL

      AND TRIM(
              TO_VARCHAR(
                  SALES_SOURCE."BillingDocumentDate"
              )
          ) <> ''

      AND TRIM(
              TO_VARCHAR(
                  SALES_SOURCE."BillingDocumentDate"
              )
          ) <> '00000000'

      AND TRIM(
              TO_VARCHAR(
                  SALES_SOURCE."BillingDocumentDate"
              )
          ) <> '0000-00-00'

      AND LENGTH(
              TRIM(
                  TO_VARCHAR(
                      SALES_SOURCE."BillingDocumentDate"
                  )
              )
          ) = 10

      AND TO_DATE(
              TRIM(
                  TO_VARCHAR(
                      SALES_SOURCE."BillingDocumentDate"
                  )
              ),
              'YYYY-MM-DD'
          ) >= ADD_MONTHS(
                   ADD_DAYS(
                       CURRENT_DATE,
                       1 - DAYOFMONTH(CURRENT_DATE)
                   ),
                   1 - CAST(
                       :P_REVN_ROLLING_AVERAGE_MONTHS
                       AS INTEGER
                   )
               )

      AND TO_DATE(
              TRIM(
                  TO_VARCHAR(
                      SALES_SOURCE."BillingDocumentDate"
                  )
              ),
              'YYYY-MM-DD'
          ) <= CURRENT_DATE

    GROUP BY
        SALES_SOURCE."CompanyCode",
        SALES_SOURCE."PayerParty",
        SALES_SOURCE."TransactionCurrency"

) REV

    ON  AR."COMPANY_CODE" = REV."COMPANY_CODE"
    AND AR."CUSTOMER" = REV."CUSTOMER"
    AND AR."CURRENCY" = REV."CURRENCY"

;
